'''Gajoru the Vault Guardian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] residing on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gajoru appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on Hutta. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
